mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (id, tenant_id, email, display_name, status, platform_role, created_at) SELECT md5(#{seed} || ':user:' || n)::uuid, #{tenantId}, #{seed} || '-' || n || '@analytics-performance.invalid', 'analytics-performance-' || n, 'ACTIVE', 'USER', #{start} FROM generate_series(1, #{accounts}) n

INSERT INTO user_identity (id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status) SELECT md5(#{seed} || ':identity:' || n)::uuid, md5(#{seed} || ':user:' || n)::uuid, 'EMAIL', 'local', #{seed} || '-' || n || '@analytics-performance.invalid', #{seed} || '-' || n || '@analytics-performance.invalid', 'ACTIVE' FROM generate_series(1, #{accounts}) n

INSERT INTO audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_user_id, event_type, details, occurred_at) SELECT md5(#{seed} || ':event:' || n)::uuid, #{tenantId}, md5(#{seed} || ':user:' || ((n % #{accounts}) + 1))::uuid, (ARRAY['APP_VISIT', 'LOGIN', 'LOGOUT', 'OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED'])[(n % 7) + 1], jsonb_build_object('analyticsVersion', 1, 'deviceType', (ARRAY['DESKTOP', 'MOBILE', 'TABLET'])[(n % 3) + 1], 'clientIp', NULL, 'country', NULL, 'province', NULL, 'city', NULL), CAST(#{start} AS timestamptz) + ((n % 365) * interval '1 day') + ((n % 24) * interval '1 hour') FROM generate_series(1, #{events}) n
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId})
